description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels. It replaces underscores and hyphens with spaces, trims whitespace, and converts the text to Title Case, handling special cases with apostrophes. The function is exported for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label with proper casing and spacing, handling special characters and null/empty inputs.
